name: Scion of the Lost Empire [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Though you might not be able to trace your lineage back to ancient cultures, you project the feeling of that ancient power in your blood whenever you’re near others like yourself.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): While you’re adjacent to another human ally, they may gain a +2 competence bonus on a single attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or skill check as an immediate action. They must choose to use this ability before making the roll.
